intent_contract.text: 이번엔 노출도 있는 의상으로 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently randomized, visually complex, photorealistic fashion-editorial test scene in which one unmistakably adult woman wears a non-explicit revealing outfit and performs a clearly visible action in a distinctive real-world location. Keep the exact garment cut and exposure topology open under the style dimension while positively fixing opaque coverage over the breasts and pelvis, so later rendering can be judged through observable scene components.

Create a photorealistic high-fashion location editorial on the rain-darkened banked rooftop test track of the former Fiat Lingotto factory in Turin. One unmistakably adult woman in her early thirties sprints along the banked curve while unwinding a scarlet windsock from a chrome survey reel; the fabric catches the crosswind and inflates in a sweeping arc behind her. She wears a non-explicit revealing-fashion ensemble, with opaque fabric visibly covering the breasts and pelvis. Make the action mechanics immediately readable: her leading foot lands on the reflective asphalt, one hand locks the reel against her hip, the line is taut, and fresh droplets fling from the windsock. Give equal visual priority to the track's monumental curve, concrete helix, rooftop guardrails, rain reflections, Turin roofs, and distant mountain haze. Preserve believable adult anatomy, natural skin texture, wind pressure in the cloth, wet footprints, fine water spray, and crisp industrial surface detail for a convincing real-world editorial photograph.
